utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Good morning to everyone. Before I call for the appearances, I note that for today and for the remainder of this week we're sitting under Rule 15 bis. Yes, may I have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. OLMSTED
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Matthew Olmsted, Tom Hannis, and Crispian Smith for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. ON behalf of Mico Stanisic's Defence team, Slobodan Cvijetic, Eugene O'Sullivan, and Tatjana Savic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic for Zupljanin Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. We have been alerted that, before we do anything else, there is an application that we would have to consider, Mr. -- well, before I call on Mr. Olmsted, are there any other preliminary matters to which we should be alerted? I guess not. Mr. Olmsted.

utterances.speaker: MR. OLMSTED
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Yes, yesterday evening the next witness informed us that he wanted protective measures. It appears this isn't the first occasion he made such a request, but due to an apparent oversight on our part, we did not include him in our last motion for protective measures. And so we would ask that the witness be heard on this issue, and the Prosecution will support this application.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: So the first step, I suppose, is to go into closed session so that we can hear from the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 20th day of July, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.47 p.m.,
